plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ruckus Unleashed wireless networks (RUCKUS-UNLEASHED-SYSTEM-MIB). It reports uptime, CPU and memory utilization, associated/registered/licensed AP counts, authorized client count, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 25053).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Unleashed master AP since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Ruckus Unleashed master AP (ruckusUnleashedSystemStatsCPUUtil, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.15.1.1.1.15.13.0), reported as a 0-100 percentage; out-of-range values are dropped at collection.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Ruckus Unleashed master AP (ruckusUnleashedSystemStatsMemoryUtil, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.15.1.1.1.15.14.0), reported as a 0-100 percentage; out-of-range values are dropped at collection.

metrics.name: wireless_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of access points currently joined to the Unleashed network (ruckusUnleashedSystemStatsNumAP, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.15.1.1.1.15.1.0). A sudden drop can indicate AP connectivity loss or a master AP failover.

metrics.name: wireless_registered_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of access points registered in the Unleashed network (ruckusUnleashedSystemStatsNumRegisteredAP, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.15.1.1.1.15.15.0). Compare with the associated AP count to spot APs that are registered but offline.

metrics.name: wireless_client_count
metrics.description: Number of authorized wireless client devices in the Unleashed network (ruckusUnleashedSystemStatsNumSta, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.15.1.1.1.15.2.0).

metrics.name: wireless_licensed_ap_count
metrics.description: Maximum number of access points allowed in the Unleashed network (ruckusUnleashedSystemLicensedAPs, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.15.1.1.1.1.12.0). When associated APs approach this limit, no further APs can join.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: Total inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes, summed from 64-bit ifHCInOctets.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: Total outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes, summed from 64-bit ifHCOutOctets.
